0022600166.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-5, on a two-game losing streak and 0-2 on the road) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (4-3, having lost their last game) for the Bucks' seventh game of the season, with Milwaukee 5th in the Central, four games back, and 14th in the East. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (out, hip bruise), and LaMelo Ball is day-to-day with a wrist injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Milwaukee lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 139-106 in Milwaukee on January 13.
